name: Nahida
notes: A Dendro support and sub-DPS. Her Skill (All Schemes to Know) carries the damage: Tri-Karma Purification takes ATK plus twice her EM, and her EM also feeds her passives, so EM is the scaling stat. The 'check' lines Tapping DMG and Hold DMG are ATK multipliers. KQM puts the Skill first and the Burst second; Game8 does too for the sub-DPS and support build (Normal Attack first only for a main DPS), so the card uses Skill, Burst, Normal Attack. The sources agree on 4pc Deepwood Memories as best, EM on the Sands, a Goblet of EM or Dendro DMG, a Circlet of EM or CRIT and A Thousand Floating Dreams first. The other sets (Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City, Tenacity of the Millelith, Golden Troupe) are KQM's by team; the other weapons are on both lists or Game8's. Goals are Game8's: EM 800 or above, ER 130-160% (upper end, inside KQM's 100-160% range by team). Partners are a judgment: Hyperbloom, Burgeon and Bloom teams from KQM's ER table.
